note: Machine source of truth for vetted MCP servers and external skill sources. Universe policy: FREE + NO SIGNUP + NO API KEY. Docs-verification is NOT liveness proof — run `python3 scripts/mcp.py check <id>|--all` at setup time; the result in .pixz/mcp-check.json is the liveness evidence.

policy.auth_required_entries: excluded (see excluded_with_reason); user-approved + user-managed credentials only

trust_tiers.T1: vendor-official server or MCP reference-server collection — live check + catalog listing
trust_tiers.T2: community-operated but documented, listed here with a named source — live check + catalog listing + tool-surface review
trust_tiers.T3: anything else — full security review + explicit user approval before wiring

sources.name: MCP Market
sources.note: Directory of MCP servers, clients and agent skills. Discovery source, not a trust source — entries still pass the VET gate.

sources.name: Vendor documentation
sources.note: Each T1 entry cites the vendor page where the endpoint + no-key claim was read.

sources.name: Curated community lists
sources.note: Community lists with public-repo requirement — used only as discovery input.

sources.name: skills.sh
sources.note: Official skill-install CLI used by PixzFlow itself (`npx skills add pixzdev/skills`).

skill_sources.name: MCP Market — Agent Skills
skill_sources.free_no_signup: official + free sections only; premium/paid listings excluded from the default universe
skill_sources.import: manual — see core/mcp/SKILL.md#skill-import-protocol-external-agent-skills (quarantine → security review → install → discover → enable)

skill_sources.free_no_signup: no install, no account, no auth

minimal.description: PixzFlow contract + orchestrator closure; no MCP (native tools only).

medium.description: Orchestrator + all optional skills; curated free remote+local set that covers docs, repo Q&A and web fetch.

full.description: Everything: all skills, full vetted catalog, skill-hub discovery, adapters + overlays.

servers.name: Context7
servers.data_flow: library name + query text sent to Upstash

verification.source: https://github.com/Upstash/context7 (README: 'configure manually, use the Context7 server URL https://mcp.context7.com/mcp'; anonymous public access unchanged, free API key only raises rate limits)

servers.notes: Up-to-date, version-specific library docs. The most-installed docs MCP. Free without key; free key raises rate limits.

servers.name: DeepWiki
servers.data_flow: repo name + question sent to Cognition

verification.source: https://mcp.deepwiki.com (live server banner: 'Connect to https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp'; private repos use a separate authenticated endpoint)

servers.notes: Ask questions about any public GitHub repo, answered from AI-generated codebase wikis.

servers.name: GitMCP (per-repo)

url_params.owner: git remote owner (auto-filled by scripts/mcp.py from `git remote get-url origin`)

servers.data_flow: repo path + requested files sent to gitmcp.io (public repos only)

verification.source: https://gitmcp.io ('Simply change the domain from github.com to gitmcp.io'; works with any public GitHub repository; no setup)

servers.notes: Instant docs/code context for the repo you are standing in. URL is per-repo — scripts/mcp.py fills the template from git.

servers.name: Microsoft Learn

verification.source: https://developer.microsoft.com/blog/improve-your-agentic-developer-tools-by-grounding-in-microsoft-learn ('one endpoint, nothing to install, no authentication required', 2026-05-29)

servers.notes: Current Microsoft/Azure documentation. Some older client builds may offer an OAuth path; the endpoint itself needs no auth per the vendor.

servers.name: Cloudflare Docs

verification.source: https://www.remote-mcp.com/servers/cloudflare-docs ('Server URL: https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/sse · Authentication: OAuth-based (no API keys required)')

servers.notes: Semantic search over Cloudflare product docs. No API key; if the client offers OAuth, read-only use works without it — re-check live at setup.

servers.name: Astro Docs

verification.source: https://deepwiki.com/withastro/docs-mcp (server card: URL https://mcp.docs.astro.build/mcp, transport http) + https://apigene.ai/mcp/official/astro

servers.notes: Grounded answers about Astro APIs, integrations and configuration.

servers.name: Wondel Skills

verification.source: https://github.com/mukul-dutt/awesome-mcp-list ('remote read-only MCP server over 50 book-based agent skills… No install, no account, no auth. Streamable HTTP: https://skills.wondel.ai/mcp')

servers.notes: Routes a task to a framework and serves the real SKILL.md in-session. Output is prompt code — apply the untrusted-output rule.

servers.name: AI Skills Search

verification.source: https://github.com/bytesagain/ai-skills (README: 'Search 60,000+ AI agent skills via MCP SSE or REST API. 7 languages. Free, no auth. Endpoint: https://bytesagain.com/api/mcp/sse')

servers.notes: Search 60k+ agent skills. Discovery only — imports still go through the quarantine review.

verification.source: https://github.com/mukul-dutt/awesome-mcp-list ('remote read-only MCP endpoint over 950+ AI-development guides (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex)… No account, no API key. Streamable HTTP: https://developertoolkit.ai/mcp')

servers.name: Useful AI Utilities

verification.source: https://github.com/sylviangth/awesome-remote-mcp-servers ('340+ autonomously-built utility tools… No authentication required. Use the server URL directly: https://api.usefulai.fun/mcp')

servers.notes: 340+ utility tools. Broad surface — activate only for tasks that actually need a specific utility.

servers.name: Fetch (reference)
servers.data_flow: requested URL fetched locally by the server process (content returns to the client)
servers.notes: Web page → markdown. First `npx` run downloads the package (needs network at setup time).

servers.name: Filesystem (reference)
servers.notes: ALWAYS scope args to the project directory ({allowed_dir} = the repo root). An unscoped filesystem server is an irreversible-capability — change-safety tier applies.

servers.name: Memory (reference)
servers.notes: Persistent knowledge-graph memory for the session project.

servers.name: Sequential Thinking (reference)
servers.notes: Structured reasoning scratchpad; useful in Deep/Autonomous mode for long derivations.

servers.name: Playwright
servers.data_flow: visited pages + DOM content; pages are rendered locally
servers.notes: Real browser automation. Capable of actions on any page the user is logged into — treat every navigation/interaction as a mutation (change-safety), and never enter credentials on the user's behalf without explicit instruction.
